evidence.reason: The deploy plan captures `pre = preflight(...)` before units are stopped and before `drain_check`, then later calls `preservation_check(effects, pre["state"])` after the helper switch. That makes the preservation comparison use a pre-drain baseline. A final tick that legitimately publishes queue/heartbeat during drain changes those files after the baseline, so the helper is falsely reported as a preservation failure even though it did not modify them. The fix is to capture the preservation digests after the stopped-unit check and successful drain, while keeping the post-helper comparison to catch writes during the switch. This is an ordinary correctness repair, not a new requirement.
